bio.text: Jean Howard-Hill is an independent candidate for U.S. House in Tennessee's 3rd District in the November 3, 2026 general election; she was also an independent candidate for the same seat in 2024.
According to Ballotpedia, she earned a bachelor's degree in urban planning and government from Wheaton College and a law degree from the University of Tennessee College of Law.
Her career experience includes working as a business executive at Howard-Hill Consultants.
